name: javascript-excel-workspace
description: Workspace for the javascript-excel library and its playground.

scripts.build: npm -w packages/javascript-excel run build && npm -w apps/playground run build
scripts.test: npm -w packages/javascript-excel run test && npm -w apps/playground run test
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/reset-pre-counter.mjs --package packages/javascript-excel && node scripts/sync-version.mjs --package packages/javascript-excel --file packages/javascript-excel/src/index.ts && npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.examples: npm run build -w packages/javascript-excel && npm run check -w examples/node -w examples/vanilla -w examples/react -w examples/vue && npm run build -w examples/vanilla -w examples/react -w examples/vue && npm start -w examples/node
scripts.docs:api: npm run build -w packages/javascript-excel && npm run build -w tools/api-docs
